infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RoofWise uses the camera to capture roof damage photos for AI analysis.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RoofWise can attach inspection photos from your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: RoofWise can save captured inspection photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RoofWise uses your location to map storm activity, find nearby leads, and log door-knocking visits.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RoofWise uses the microphone for voice-to-text notes during inspections.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: RoofWise uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice notes.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: RoofWise uses motion sensors to measure roof pitch and detect slope orientation.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow RoofWise to access your camera to capture roof damage photos.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow RoofWise to use your location to map storms, leads, and door-knocking routes.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow RoofWise to access your photo library to attach inspection photos.
